purpose: Historical or ongoing single-drive report combining recorded journey facts, telemetry, energy/cost estimates, supervised-driving evidence, physics ledger and diagnostics.
primaryGoal: Understand what happened on this specific drive, inspect source limitations, and navigate, replay, print or share without losing specialist evidence.

dataSources.behavior: Record-keyed query; AbortSignal forwarded; live=true alone enables fast polling. Telemetry preferred over position fallback; SI wire/cache values remain unchanged by presentation derivation.
Vehicle follows the loaded drive, not an independent page selector. Backend registration was not inspected for this endpoint.
Vehicle, drive_id, timezone and include_evidence scope; historical query policy; record contribution selected by drive_id. Both fatal and retained-refresh errors are distinguished.
Vehicle-history baselines; missing baselines must not suppress recorded drive measurements.
Historical independent source with loading, fatal-error retry, retained-refresh warning, empty state and explicit unknown terms.
Separate historical queries with cancellation and source-specific honesty text; nullable transitions and unknown FSD reporting remain distinct from negative findings.
Expanded-panel enablement and independent diagnostic window. Road findings are inferred candidates, not confirmed potholes.
Public-token generation, copy/open and revocation; optional title, speed/detail consent and expiry choices. No mutations exercised.
Opt-in ADR-015 feature gates, explicit Generate actions and scope-key cancellation. Endpoint strings inspected in consumers; router registration not established by this bounded audit.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The identical normalizeDriveId predicate and associated drive-stream URL setup also appear in AIDriveCoaching.tsx:41. Presentation already reuses AIFeatureCard; no need for another AI card.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: If these shared AI owners are assigned together, reuse one existing-domain ID normalizer while preserving zero/blank rejection and independent scope keys. Do not expand this page writer's ownership.

issues.detail: View/expiry metadata uses a non-wrapping flex row while neighboring copy/revoke actions occupy fixed space. Potential squeezing with long localized dates; actual overflow is unverified.
issues.fix: Review 320px and 200% text; allow metadata wrapping and action-row reflow locally if reproduced, retaining all title, expiry, count and controls.

observations: Page line 87 localizes the icon-only back action and marks its icon decorative.
DriveDetailSection.tsx:18 labels each semantic section; jump links have visible-focus classes.
Ledger terms have column/row scopes and separate accessible table labels; unknown values are textual.
WhyEndedPanel.tsx:161-162 and RoadAnomalyPanel.tsx:60-61 expose expanded/control relationships.

issues.detail: Back and Replay compose Link around Button (Replay at lines 91-95). This is a potential nested-interactive composition; the Button renderer was not inspected, so invalid DOM and duplicate focus targets are not claimed as verified.
issues.fix: Inspect shared Button output and exercise keyboard/navigation; if it renders a native button, use the established navigation/button-chrome composition rather than nested interactive elements.

issues.detail: Decorative MapPin next to the visible Route label lacks explicit aria-hidden in caller source; actual SVG accessibility output was not exercised.
issues.fix: Explicitly hide decorative map/title glyphs and verify the route map's keyboard/text alternative without removing route or FSD evidence.

states.loading: Page.tsx:113 retains skeleton alongside the complete outline; independent FSD, ledger, gear and silent sources own loading placeholders.
states.empty: Page.tsx:117-120 has record-not-found context; section owner retains labeled unavailable panels; telemetry gap is additional context, not a report deletion.
states.error: Page.tsx:114-115 provides fatal-record retry; independent SectionErrorBoundary contains presentation failures.
states.retainedRefresh: Page.tsx:122-123 preserves historical drive/FSD data and warnings; ledger, gear, silent, road and baselines use useDataState.
states.offline: No page-specific offline indicator verified; inherited useDataState/feedback implementations were not inspected.
states.unknown: Ledger term unknown flags, missing_signals, nullable energy and unexplained_known remain explicit. Position-derived chart gaps stay null.

issues.detail: The branch uses why.error directly to replace diagnostic timeline/signals even if TanStack Query retains why.data on a refresh failure. Unlike adjacent panels it has no useDataState fatal-versus-refresh distinction.
issues.fix: Reuse useDataState, replace only on fatalError with no retained payload, and show StaleRefreshWarning plus retry while preserving retained timeline and signal table.

issues.detail: sharesError replaces the existing-share list even when existingShares is retained. Error banner offers no direct refetch action in this component.
issues.fix: Use existing data-state/refresh-warning contracts and actionable retry without dropping retained links, copy controls or revoke actions.

visualIssues.detail: Speed segments use feature-owned #10b981/#ef4444/#f59e0b/#00f0ff; the cyan band is overtly neon. RouteMapSection.tsx:163-182 additionally owns fixed FSD/endpoint colors and lines 215-218 duplicate the palette in legend utilities.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current semantic/chart palette via its existing shared owner; keep all SI thresholds, route segments, start/end identity, dashed approximate FSD overlay and legend labels. Do not reset saved chart/theme choices.

visualIssues.detail: Route heading and popup/legend copy retain raw text-sm/text-xs/font-semibold/font-bold styling despite existing PanelTitle/Text owners.
visualIssues.fix: Use current role typography while preserving h3/span semantics and readable map overlay density; no independent scale.

visualIssues.detail: Success text uses fixed text-green-400; headings/copy use ad-hoc raw typography and revoke glyph uses text-red-400 at line 204.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic success/danger and typography tokens while retaining status text and destructive-action name; measure contrast on actual modal surfaces.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature presentation imports CardGrid/useCardPlacement/type CardGridItem from the internal layout-reference owner rather than the category barrel specified by the design contract. Existing placement adapter is useful and should not be replaced.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the established layout category export for supported APIs; if placement APIs are not exposed, have the exclusive layout owner assess the barrel rather than add another grid or edit shared code in the page task.

architectureIssues.detail: Nullable route speed is collapsed to zero (position fallback also at line 67), then every route segment receives a speed-band color. Missing speed is consequently indistinguishable from measured low speed on the map, despite null-preserving chart derivation.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve nullable speed through the route presentation type and render missing-speed segments with an explicit neutral/unknown legend state; keep coordinates, all segments and SI thresholds. Treat as a separately verified data-trust fix, not a cosmetic calculation rewrite.

priority.reason: Most root-page modernization is already present. Prioritize retained diagnostic/share refresh data and missing-speed trust; then local palette/typography and verified interaction issues. Avoid wholesale report rewrites.

competingImplementations.detail: Local map segment colors plus separately hardcoded legend classes compete with the existing shared palette contract.
competingImplementations.fix: Adopt the current palette owner in this feature; no new global palette or map component.

preservation.sectionEvidence: DriveReportContent.tsx:58-176; measured 21 <DriveDetailSection JSX instances. Root has zero direct GlassPanel/ChartContainer instances because presentation is decomposed; not evidence of missing sections.
actions: Map layer selection and route navigation

ledger.nullableInvariant: Missing terms/values/signals do not become zero. Retain term method and missing-signal detail, nullable dynamics, unknown flags and both tables in all viewport layouts.

dataBehavior: Specific routed record owns scope; do not add a second workspace date/vehicle selector or replace drive evidence with selected workspace history.
Keep vehicle-scoped baseline history distinct from per-drive aggregates; date/vehicle timezone remains existing-owner behavior.
SI source fields remain m, s, m/s, Wh and W; pressure samples explicitly pass Pa/1000 to the existing kPa formatter. Display preference conversion only; do not persist presentation values.
Telemetry samples retain null speed, battery, temperatures, range, odometer, pressure, power and climate evidence; sparse endpoint scans and typed historical-position aliases remain.
Preserve persisted aggregate versus estimated-energy attribution, configured-rate-not-invoice costs and gas-equivalence settings.
Keep eight navigation groups, all 21 section wrappers, independent queries, errors and specialist honesty/uncertainty text.
Do not change energy integration or derived-stat formulas during a visual migration; zero fallbacks in internal stats need consumer-specific proof before any broader nullability change.
AI sections remain opt-in, off-mode hidden and independently record-scoped; baseline deterministic sections never depend on AI enablement.
preservation.lineCountComparison: No implementation or historical baseline comparison performed. Root snapshot is 146 lines; extracted component total was not measured.
